question: Under which Article of the Indian Constitution are Fundamental Duties mentioned?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 51 A**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 51A of the Indian constitution states about Fundamental duties in India
 
• They **were added to the constitution by the 42nd Amendment in 197**6 by the recommendation of the **Swaran Singh Committee.**
 
• The concept of fundamental duties of the Indian constitution was borrowed from the **USSR(__**Union of Soviet Socialist Republics**__).__**
 
• The **Fundamental duties are set out in Part IV-A **of the constitution and cannot be forced on the citizens until made as parliamentary law.
 
• Originally, **there were only 10 fundamental duties, the 11th was added by the 86th Amendment in 2002.**
 
• It is **not enforceable by the court of the law**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• There are **11 fundamental duties**, they are:

 
 
• Abide by the Constitution and respect national flag & National Anthem.
 
• Follow ideals of the freedom struggle.
 
• Protect sovereignty & integrity of India.
 
• Defend the country and render national services when called upon.
 
• **Sprit of a common brotherhood**.
 
• Preserve composite culture.
 
• **Preserve the natural environment**.
 
• Develop a scientific temper.
 
• **Safeguard public property.**
 
• Strive for excellence.
 
• Duty fo all parents/guardians to send their children in the age group of 6-14 years to school.
